interface.shortDescription: Idea to clickable prototype to production iOS and Android app, with Claude Code or Codex
interface.longDescription: A free, open-source plugin for Claude Code and Codex. A product advisor shapes your idea, you click through a prototype of every screen, then your agent builds and wires an Expo + FastAPI + Supabase app with auth, analytics, CI, store builds and an agent harness. Rae, the advisor, lets you ramble about the idea and checks the market in the background; a design team builds the prototype, and you tune its look, layouts, density, motion and features before anything is built. Then it walks you through free-tier accounts, provisions the cloud resources and installs CI, PR review, skills, subagents, hooks and memory that work the same in Codex and Claude Code.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $new-app to build my app idea in this folder.
